Abstract base class for exploreDE's storage-agnostic dataset wrapper

Source: R/ExploreDataset.R
ExploreDataset.Rd

ExploreDataset defines the accessor contract that every concrete subclass must implement. It is not instantiable on its own — calling ExploreDataset$new() raises an error. Use new_explore_dataset() to build a concrete instance, or instantiate a subclass directly.

Methods implemented on the base class read only from private$.config and are inherited unchanged by every subclass. Methods that touch the storage backend are virtual (stop("not implemented")) and must be overridden.

Value

An R6 class generator. $new() always errors; the concrete subclasses return an object inheriting from ExploreDataset.

Examples

se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
#> Loading required namespace: SummarizedExperiment
eds <- new_explore_dataset(se)
inherits(eds, "ExploreDataset")
#> [1] TRUE
eds$contrasts()
#> [1] "B_vs_A"
head(eds$de(eds$primary_contrast()))
